note: One of the bar pieces: a row of n cells on a row of n + 1, with one cell under the left end. Every n = 1 (mod 4) gives a 2(n+1) x (n+3) tiling with n + 3 copies (tools/bar-family.ts). Other lengths behave very differently: n = 3 needs 180 copies, n = 4 needs 138 and n = 8 needs 468, while n = 6 and 7 are open.

rectifiable.note: Not resolved by this site's searches. Exact searches (column searches, then exact width automata from tools/exact-width-sweep.ts) rule out every rectangle with a side of at most 169, and every half-strip of width at most 169.

order.note: Every tileable rectangle has both sides above 169, so it holds at least 1807 copies; the piece may not tile any rectangle.
